raw_text: Has anyone verified this LoC crossing drone footage making rounds on Telegram and Twitter? The frame rates look inconsistent — switching between 24fps and 30fps mid-clip. Also the thermal overlay seems artificially composited over separate terrain footage. The EXIF data someone extracted shows stock footage metadata from a commercial provider.
clean_text: Analysis of the LoC crossing drone footage reveals frame-rate inconsistencies and artificially composited thermal overlays. EXIF data points to stock footage origins.
